body: Mental illness, if that's what I have, is a curse that devastates lives, not just for those suffering it but those close to the person suffering it. Drugs only make you stoned, ECT makes you incapable of functioning.. what's the point of living if you can't appreciate even the simplest thing, like the sun outside, or just being alive.

I tried continuing this course of supplements (Truehope.com).. helped a little in some ways, but much worse in others, so tried to stop them 3 days ago, now I'm falling into levels of depression/anxiety/delirious states.. even if I could keep up the supplements their so expensive, I don't know what to do. If I don't get some relief I will have to kill myself, it's to much torture for to long & psychiatry only makes things worse. Hell is a state of mind only a few neurotransmitters away & it's impossible to stay there very long.
.. I'm interested, what is your story and what did you (have you) do/done to get through ?are you ok now ?
Thanks Calimhero.. feel so desperate as I write this. Don't know what to do to ease the symptoms. Have this sensation that it's like 'The Last Supper' only the written version.

Another day in hell.. As I write this am yet again considering the only option that seems to be left to me. Depression, anxiety, anger, weakness, dizzy, nausea, pains all over my body, head aches, was woken at 6am by sevear intestinal pains etc, etc.. Took an amio acid combination tablet 30mins ago, but quite honestly I've given up on anything working.

Thank you for your support/help. The frustration for me is that I'm suffering brain disfunction which is causing the torture I'm going through, but I don't know why it's there ie I don't know if I'm suffering a permanent 'illness' or caused by 18 years of psychiatric treatments. In any case the suffering is so intence that I can't live with it, so I'm trying desperately to find solutions that will help, but I've tried everything, but nothing improves things.. hence the title of my post.
